quest.title: In the City of Geo Live the Adepti
quest.description: Materials which are used to make lanterns are all easily flammable, and they're piling up at Liyue's port. Between the mountains of materials, you saw a mysterious figure, which shortly got annoyed by your presence and told you off. You and Paimon shared a look and stared at the piles of wood, paper, and oil... You have a bad feeling about this and you went to the Ministry of Civil Affairs to report the situation. Now you're wondering how they're handling the situation, and you've decided to go and see.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wonders what progress the Ministry of Civil Affairs is making.

talks.objective: Talk to Jiayi at the Ministry of Civil Affairs

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Erm... Ah yes, you two were here yesterday to report some suspicious activity.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I... *sigh* I won't lie to you, the Ministry of Civil Affairs is unbelievably busy during Lantern Rite. We simply don't have the staff to cover this case at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? Are you kidding me!?

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I do hate to let you down like this, and I appreciate that you took the trouble to report this out of the goodness of your hearts. Hmm, I wonder if...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I do believe we have one smaller squad that just might be able to help. They only have one assignment left today.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: They are currently subduing the monster presence at the Guili Plains. If you are able to make contact with them...

talks.objective: Defeat the hilichurls and their roadblock

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's a hilichurl blockade! Paimon wonders what they're doing here... Waiting to ambush someone, maybe?

talks.objective: Talk to the squad of the Millelith

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: The monster presence has been duly investigated. Dismissed! ...Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: Who are you with?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Jiayi sent us to find you, he said...

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: I see. I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: The Ministry of Civil Affairs is grateful for your support. Your case is well noted and will be scheduled for investigation as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Xinghuo
dialogues.text: May our paths cross again in Liyue, kind travelers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon is starting to feel like...

choices.text: The ministry isn't taking this seriously.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! Paimon thinks so too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The locals must take all their tasty treats for granted by now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But for a poor traveler, all alone out in the wilderness, often forced to survive on nothing but the most mysterious of mushrooms...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: For you, the Lantern Rite is the most important of all festivals!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So let's go back to the place where we witnessed the shady-looking guy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon hears from patrol officers that criminals love to go back for another look at the crime scene after the event. Eh, it's a psychological thing, apparently.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But the crime hasn't even happened yet...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's why there's no time to lose! When there's highly flammable materials involved, once the crime happens it'll be too late!

choices.text: We should take this into our own hands.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks so too!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: With our wealth of experience adventuring far and wide, we should be able to get to the bottom of this.

talks.objective: Go back to the crime scene

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aha! Knew it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, there's another person—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey {NICKNAME}, Paimon reckons this guy is gonna make a difficult conversation partner...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If Paimon was gonna hazard a guess, Paimon would say he's definitely not one of the good guys!

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Your hazardous guesswork is a woefully insufficient means of judging between good and evil.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Nevertheless, you surmise correctly. I am a malevolent spirit. A guardian yaksha, slaughterer of monsters and vanquisher of demons - Xiao.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guardian Yaksha!

choices.text: I'm sure I heard that term the other day.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes... Someone from Liyue was telling us that yakshas are also a kind of adeptus. Supernatural beings that protect Liyue.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: They stand guard over the human world in secret, protecting it from monsters and demons. But most people don't even know they exist.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Wait, doesn't that make you the good guys by most definitions?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: ...No. Do not mistake the yakshas' guardianship for some sort of good will towards humanity.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, charming! There's a whole city of humans out there working hard to prepare for Lantern Rite, all for the sake of honoring the heroes of Liyue's history...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Turns out we have here an actual historical hero, who has miraculously survived through to this day... and yet, he doesn't even appreciate the gesture!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, Mr. Xiao... Uh, that is, assuming "Mr." is the correct way to address an adeptus... Why didn't you stop that shady character earlier?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I sensed a malign influence here. I'm here to investigate.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: When a shackle is loosened in the realms of deities and demons, I take full responsibility.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: But this time, the threat comes from the mortal world — your world. Thus you shall take full responsibility, mortal traveler.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: When the time comes, I hope you shall act promptly and decisively...

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: I do not wish for the tassel of the polearm that has slaughtered countless demons to become stained with mortal blood.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's this?

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: A symbol that your suspected evildoer left behind.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon, do you recognize it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Doesn't look familiar to Paimon.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Well, you will have to show me how much you can accomplish on your own strength.

response.speaker: Xiao
response.text: Because if I become involved, there is a possibility that the streets of Liyue Harbor will be painted red this Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Actually, quite a festive color in this part of the world...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds terrible!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahh, let's not be impulsive. Why don't we figure out the origins of this symbol first?

choices.text: Paimon, do you know what a yaksha is?
